r18b-001.gate_key: ind_advanced | B2.2 | mcq | Which sentence has a mistake? | We still haven't decided if to rent a car in Crete.

key.correct: We still haven't decided if to rent a car in Crete.
wrong: Everything now depends on whether the bank approves our loan.
If the train is delayed, I'll take a taxi.
Could you check whether the hotel has a lift?

item.why: Before *to* + verb only *whether* is possible: *We still haven't decided whether to rent a car*. *If* needs a subject and a verb: *if we should rent a car*.
item.why_lv: Pirms to + darbības vārds var būt *tikai whether*: *We still haven't decided whether to rent a car.* Aiz *if* vajag teikuma priekšmetu un darbības vārdu: *if we should rent a car*.
